title: 2.1.10 Sprite Playground
description: Build a sprite playground combining canvas, WASD-controlled sprite, auto-motion, and on-screen text. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Create a canvas and two sprites
steps.instructions: Make a canvas (any size between 300×300 and 800×600) and two sprites — one `player` (controllable) and one `mover` (moves on its own).

steps.title: Wire WASD movement to the player
steps.instructions: Use `kb.pressing('a')` / `'d'` / `'w'` / `'s'` to set the player's velocity. Include an else branch that resets velocity to 0 when no key is held.
hints: Don't use arrow keys in this lab — they also scroll the browser iframe.

steps.title: Animate the mover sprite
steps.instructions: Drive the `mover` sprite with `frameCount` so it moves on its own. Pick any pattern: oscillate, orbit, or spin.

steps.title: Add an on-screen text label
steps.instructions: Display a message on the canvas using `text()` and `textSize()`. Your choice of message.
hints: Set `fill(255)` before `text(...)` so it's visible on dark backgrounds.

steps.title: Clear the background each frame
steps.instructions: Make sure `background(...)` is called each frame so previous frames don't stack up.

requirements.title: Else-to-zero on velocity
requirements.description: Reset player.vel.x (or .y) to 0 in an else branch

requirements.title: Use frameCount for auto-motion
requirements.description: Reference frameCount somewhere (for the mover sprite)
